load_openapi_spec_from_file: load an OpenAPI spec from a local file path or remote URL
get_base_url_from_spec: extract the base URL from an OpenAPI specification dictionary
build_input_schema_from_operation: build an MCP input schema from an OpenAPI operation object
create_tool_function_for_endpoint: create an async tool function for an OpenAPI endpoint with path and query parameters
register_tools_from_openapi_spec: register MCP tools from a loaded OpenAPI specification dictionary
